name: Light Sand Between Finish Coats
intent: Light fine-grit sand of cured first finish coat to flatten any nibs, brush marks, or laydown imperfections before the second finish coat. Always followed by vacuum dust. QT4 and QT5 only — lower tiers don't sand between coats.
doctrine: Interstage sanding uses a finer grit than first-pass primer sanding (320+ at QT5, 220-320 at QT4) and slows accordingly. Cannot be skipped at QT4/QT5 — the second coat needs a clean key to bond uniformly and the sanded surface eliminates any first-coat texture artifacts. Vacuum is mandatory before the second spray pass.
